profile_text.body:
Netflix is a publicly traded entertainment company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, trading under the ticker NFLX. Its investor site describes it as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a range of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time, according to the company.

The same material states that Netflix has over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries, with members enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. The company's own description of itself centers on streaming entertainment and games rather than on AI products, and no AI products are named in the available material.

Beyond the company profile, the held facts record litigation exposure in California, with 281 cases noted. No lawsuits, products or MCP servers are listed for the company.
